title: Divisibility by 3 and 5 (Hi-Hello)

content.problemStatement: Given an integer value, if it is divisible by 3 print “Hi”, if it is divisible by 5 print “Hello”. If it is divisible by both print “HiHello”

solution.approach: FizzBuzz style branching: divisible by 3 and 5 -> HiHello, by 3 -> Hi, by 5 -> Hello.
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Check divisibility by 15 first for 'HiHello', then by 3 for 'Hi', then by 5 for 'Hello'.

hints: Check condition for both 3 and 5 first (e.g. n % 15 == 0).
